# TABLES
customers (4,000 rows; one row per customer)
  customer_id VARCHAR -- unique customer key, customer_city VARCHAR -- city of the customer, customer_region VARCHAR -- one of North/South/East/West/Central, signup_date DATE -- date the customer registered, acquisition_channel VARCHAR -- organic, paid_search, social, email, affiliate
sellers (180 rows; one row per seller (marketplace merchant)
response:
WITH quarter_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) AS quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS cancellation_rate,
        AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_ts >= DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_ts <  DATE '2025-10-01'
    GROUP BY quarter
),
q2 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM quarter_metrics
    WHERE quarter = DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2025-04-01')
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM quarter_metrics
    WHERE quarter = DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2025-07-01')
)
SELECT
    metric,
    ROUND(q2_value, 4) AS q2_2025,
    ROUND(q3_value, 4) AS q3_2025,
    ROUND(change, 4)   AS change
FROM (
    SELECT
        'orders_count'      AS metric,
        q2.orders_count     AS q2_value,
        q3.orders_count     AS q3_value,
        q3.orders_count - q2.orders_count AS change
    FROM q2, q3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'aov'               AS metric,
        q2.revenue / NULLIF(q2.orders_count, 0) AS q2_value,
        q3.revenue / NULLIF(q3.orders_count, 0) AS q3_value,
        (q3.revenue / NULLIF(q3.orders_count, 0)) - (q2.revenue / NULLIF(q2.orders_count, 0)) AS change
    FROM q2, q3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'cancellation_rate' AS metric,
        q2.cancellation_rate AS q2_value,
        q3.cancellation_rate AS q3_value,
        q3.cancellation_rate - q2.cancellation_rate AS change
    FROM q2, q3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'avg_review_score'  AS metric,
        q2.avg_review_score AS q2_value,
        q3.avg_review_score AS q3_value,
        q3.avg_review_score - q2.avg_review_score AS change
    FROM q2, q3
) AS decomposed
ORDER BY metric;
